page.overview:
Who is Alba Davinos?

Alba was born as the daughter of General Raimond Davinos, head of the Vassal House of Davinos, and his wife, Lady Maya. She has an older brother, Julien, the heir of the house.

In the year 71 after the Shapers' War Lady Maya and her daughter Alba had been staying in the Golden Orchard with the Royce family, while General Raimond and Sir Julien were in Dol-Makjar with Lady Aranessa Royce after her husband, Thjazi Fang, was sentenced to death. However, in the following days, after the Palazzo Davinos was attacked, the safety of both noble families was compromised, and Sir Julien, when he had the chance in Riesingürtle, wrote a letter to his mother, wondering if she and Alba were ok, and asking them to look for a safer place to stay in, somewhere only he could find them.

When the Golden Orchard was attacked, Alba was amongst the survivors after the demiplane fell; however, during the fight against the Tachonis forces, one of the latter, Koral Tachonis, used the "Wraith's Touch" (a necromantic curse) against her, running away with the focus but being himself targetted by a curse that forced him to dance to a Davinos tune. When her mother, Maya, described her situation to Julien she told her that Alba's fingers were starting to become ghost-like, and that she would die in less than a year if the curse wasn't lifted, fully turning into a spirit.
